scope: spacr.embeddings only; no generic teacher/EmbeddingSpec/torch_artifacts/UI changes
input: Full raw numeric finite NHWC crops; saved source_channels select physical planes exactly once. No generic embedding normalization or scale estimation.
load: Existing load_model_artifact(path, map_location="cpu", weights_only=True, strict=True), local-only; refuse non-own-DINO artifacts. Saved classes must match num_classes and be distinct nonblank strings.
features: Factor identical existing preprocessing/encoder/feature normalization into nested Classifier.features; forward calls head(features(images)). No new state or training changes.

output.logits: float32 N x saved class width
output.predictions: saved class labels indexed by argmax
output.checkpoint_sha256: actual saved classifier artifact digest, not teacher source digest

tests: Synthetic local TinyEncoder artifacts only; no training/download/model or GPU. Project/per-channel and normalize-feature variants compare direct restored model logits/features with reordered physical planes, saved scales and batch partitions; input/artifact unchanged; unsafe pickle, unknown artifact, malformed classes/input/source indices refuse.
